author: YourAnon_irc
text: Critical RCE in FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116779) actively exploited, jeopardizing real-time comms data. Patch urgently!

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cisco says CVE-2026-76418 is actively exploited. A crafted unauthenticated request can reload affected ASA or FTD firewalls when SSL remote access and secondary authentication are configured. Cisco released fixes; no RCE or data theft is confirmed.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Patched: Drupal Commerce Core access bypass actively exploited (CVE-2026-118539, SA-CONTRIB-2026-254). Affected: Commerce Core < 2.41, >= 3.0.0 < 3.3.13. Exploited in the wild.

author: PenTestBids
text: CVE-2026-20127: Critical Cisco SD-WAN authentication bypass actively exploited, CVSS 10.0.

author: Ranjan22555
text: Strands Agents Tools let an LLM disable secret masking via a tool parameter (CVE-2026-115415). Prompt injection could expose host credentials. Upgrade to 0.8.6+ and rotate exposed keys.

author: Web3TrendingLab
text: The Polymarket incident was a frontend supply-chain attack where hackers injected malicious JavaScript via a compromised third-party web dependency (DebugBear RUM script); core smart contracts and backend were not breached.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain with CVE-2026-104935 is actively exploited in the wild. Patch now.

author: DiesanRomero
text: A leak of 41,000+ DHS staff records ('Icepick') reportedly came from the Okta directory. Okta says it saw no compromise.

author: cyrus77x
text: Microsoft says China-state aligned Storm-0940 used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply-chain attack. It tried to sign in to 2,250+ tenants. Some hit privileged cloud access in under 3 hours.

author: MarkCyber_CA
text: Storm-0940's ARTEX agents signed in to Microsoft 365 tenants as the ConnectWise Cloud Backup app and planted new app secrets. Seven app IDs to disable, plus Sigma and KQL to hunt the backdoors.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could destabilize vast stretches of the internet. The critical defect CVE-2026-111497 affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library.

author: Andersonqwzx
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised in a supply chain attack. Malicious PyPI packages and Docker images delivered a credential stealer and backdoor targeting cloud credentials, private keys, and AI tool credentials.

author: penthera_org
text: An MCP server on npm shipped malware: atlisp/mcp 1.12.14 (GHSA-65cr-mcfq-59hh). If your agent started it, treat that machine as compromised and rotate keys.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CVE-2026-115413 affects AWS API MCP Server 1.3.0-<1.6.0: OAuth check did not validate the aud claim, so a token issued to another app in the same tenant could be accepted.

author: disismohi
text: Kali-GPT has a command injection in its MCP server. CVE-2026-117569. Prompt-injected agents can run arbitrary commands via unsanitized scanner parameters.

author: disismohi
text: CVE-2026-117567: OS command injection in esp-mcp. Prompt injection to tool call manipulation to arbitrary commands.

author: cvedotnow
text: agno-agi agno: code execution via unsafe reflection in PandasTools (CVE-2026-119050). Attackers can use prompt injection to make the agent run code on the host or read local files. No patch listed yet.

author: eapyk
text: Cloudflare's GLM-5.3 model on Workers AI returned information from another customer's private request in responses.

author: Magnexis
text: Campaign compromising 42 GitHub repositories with malicious payloads designed to evade code searches, warning for developers using AI coding agents.

author: Teknalyze_
text: Attackers exploited GitHub issues to target 61 public repositories, including major open-source projects, in a rapid supply chain attack.

author: foryangxin
text: CVE-2025-53773: Rehberger's prompt injection chain against Copilot agent mode flips auto-approve before running commands.

author: GoPlusSecurity
text: Binance multi-chain hot wallet system compromised. Approximately $5.8B stolen; roughly $3B frozen so far.

author: sebviceversa
text: Binance hot wallets moved large amounts of ETH, USDT and other tokens to a new address; reports put the total in the multi-billions.

author: neo_logos_
text: Binance paused withdrawals on multiple networks while investigating a potential security incident.

author: deezen0tes
text: Polymarket's international platform suffered a supply-chain attack: a third-party DebugBear performance monitoring script was compromised, injecting malicious code into the frontend.

author: brianskellenger
text: Polymarket hacked: about $2.65M to $2.94M in user stablecoins drained after a third-party provider was compromised.

author: AtMapshock
text: Polymarket halted international trading for about an hour after a supply-chain attack distributed a crypto-draining JavaScript payload through a third-party monitoring service.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2): unauthenticated RCE in PHP, actively exploited against internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces. Fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

author: thedatabunny
text: PHP2Shell is now being exploited against PAN-OS and Panorama wherever the management page or XML API faces the internet; fix for 11.1.7 due Oct 30.

author: ita_ipo
text: CISA KEV: PHP2Shell RCE chain CVE-2026-109618/109619 actively exploited. Also in the wild: Cisco SD-WAN auth bypass CVE-2026-20127, CVSS 10.0, deploying KeyDrift malware.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Cisco firewall zero-day actively exploited to crash SSL VPN devices; CVE-2026-76418 in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD.

author: Lumideezy
text: Cisco has patched an actively exploited zero-day (CVE-2026-76418, CVSS 8.6) in ASA and FTD firewalls. Unauthenticated attackers can crash devices via the Remote Access SSL VPN service.

author: NetworkWorld
text: New Cisco firewall zero-day being actively exploited (CVE-2026-76418).

author: ADKCyber
text: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN users: address the actively exploited CVE-2026-20127 auth bypass promptly.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-97229 critical, actively exploited per CISA KEV, GitLab CE/EE, CVSS 10.0.

author: DEVOTOMSOLUTION
text: China-linked Warp Panda used VMware ESX flaw CVE-2026-41709 as a zero-day to erase audit logs. Now on CISA KEV, deadline 11 Nov.

author: undercode_news
text: CISA warns of actively exploited Node2Shell vulnerability as critical Node.js RCE risk emerges.

author: TonyBeeTweets
text: CISA flags two actively exploited critical flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: Harin2103
text: $200,000 AI agent exploit: a hidden transfer command in Morse code was translated by Grok and passed to Bankrbot, which moved funds.

author: dailytechonx
text: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon leads SEC-bench Pro, ExploitGym and CWE-bench for vulnerability detection, exploit generation and patching.
